title: Mean-payoff parity games in quasipolynomial time

issues.description: The whole result depends on the companion preprint OAI 'Deterministic quasipolynomial-time mean-payoff games' (Thm 1.1 for the winning-set algorithm, Cor 7.1 for global positional optimal strategies under liminf). This is not a gap inside this paper, but the theorem is only as sound as that companion result. The interface used (threshold 0, liminf, one global positional strategy per player, vertex weights turned into edge weights, binary inputs) matches what the paper says it imports.
issues.evidence: Proof of Prop. 2.1 only cites [OpenAI2026Deterministic, Thm 1.1, Cor 7.1]; a sibling review on the hive board (same family) confirms the interface matches.

coverage: Read the full LaTeX: Sections 1–5. Checked line by line: Lemma 2.2 (cycle-deletion prefix bound); the attractor and dominion facts in Lemma 2.3 (i)–(iii); Lemma 3.1, both the odd case and the even case, including the round structure, the count of at most 1+sqrt(2T) rounds, the constant K_δ=B+C_δ+(1+|H|)W, and the inequality K√(2T) ≤ εT/2+K²/ε (the discriminant is exactly 0); Theorem 3.2 (determinacy induction with the attractor-of-winners reduction and the single-switch prefix bound); Lemma 3.3 (dominion extraction: R_D⊆R by attractor avoidance, mean payoff inherited by the Min-dominion D, lifting via closure); Theorem 4.1 (termination by number of priorities, preservation of P-dominions, removal of Q-dominions using b−⌊b/2⌋−1 ≤ ⌊b/2⌋, nonempty phase return certifying U_mp(U)=U); Prop. 5.1 (depth ≤ n, at most one unchanged-bounds child, M=2(n+1), h=2(1+⌊log n⌋), sum ≤ (n+1)(h+1)(nM)^h) and the final bit-complexity composition. Skipped the history section.
main_claim: A deterministic algorithm computes the Max winning region of mean-payoff parity games (liminf mean payoff ≥ 0 together with min-parity, binary rewards and priorities) in 2^{O(log^2(L+2))} bit operations. It does this with a Parys-style bounded-dominion recursion that makes 2^{O(log^2 n)} calls to a quasipolynomial ordinary mean-payoff solver, backed by a strategy-combination lemma with uniform prefix bounds.
sibling_notes: A sibling branch had already reported on this exact dir with no_gap_found and the same companion-dependence caveat. My independent review agrees. I updated the board entry and kept both reviews in it.
